"""Descriptive statistics for two unrelated reports."""

import math


def exam_summary(results):
    values = [r["score"] for r in results if r["score"] is not None]
    if not values:
        return {"count": 0}
    count = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / count
    variance = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in values) / count
    stddev = math.sqrt(variance)
    low, high = min(values), max(values)
    return {
        "count": count,
        "mean": round(mean, 2),
        "stddev": round(stddev, 2),
        "range": (low, high),
    }


def describe_response_times(log_lines):
    values = []
    for line in log_lines:
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) == 3 and parts[2].endswith("ms"):
            values.append(float(parts[2][:-2]))
    if not values:
        return "no samples"
    count = len(values)
    mean = sum(values) / count
    variance = sum((v - mean) ** 2 for v in values) / count
    stddev = math.sqrt(variance)
    low, high = min(values), max(values)
    return f"n={count} mean={mean:.1f}ms sd={stddev:.1f}ms min={low:.0f}ms max={high:.0f}ms"
